name: oauthlib-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is OAuthLib. Its implementation no longer matches the behavior its own documentation specifies. The scope of this task is the entire repository: every module of the `oauthlib` package together with every documentation page under `docs/` and the project README. Restore the documented behavior everywhere within that scope.

The documentation this repository ships is the authority: the reStructuredText under `docs/`, the project README, and the public docstrings of the `oauthlib` package. Where the implementation and that documentation disagree, the documentation is correct. Read those contracts together with the code before changing behavior.

Change the implementation, not the documentation. Keep the public API and the behavior that already matches its documentation intact.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
